meta.title: About us — a small team for websites, software and AI from Sofia
meta.description: Web Devs Bulgaria Ltd. builds websites, applications and AI solutions for small and medium businesses. See how we work, the principles we follow and what you get as a client.

title: About us
lead: Web Devs Bulgaria builds websites, applications and AI solutions. We make them so that a business can rely on them every day.

sections.title: Who we are
sections.text: A small team of developers with experience in building and maintaining websites and platforms used daily by real users. We have worked on corporate websites, e-learning systems, customer portals, AI assistants, integrations and server infrastructure. With us you talk directly to the people who write the code.

sections.title: How we see the work
sections.text: Software is a means, not an end. Before we propose a solution, we want to understand the problem. Sometimes the best solution is smaller and cheaper than you expected — and we will tell you so.

sections.title: What you get
sections.text: One team responsible for the whole project. A fixed price before we start. Code and documentation that remain yours. Clear deadlines, regular demos and maintenance after launch.

values.title: Clarity
values.text: We speak plainly and say what can and what cannot be done.

values.title: Accountability
values.text: What we launch, we maintain. We do not leave a client alone with a problem.

values.title: Quality
values.text: We write code that the next developer can read and continue.

values.title: Security
values.text: Data protection is considered from day one, not added at the end.
